title: GSAE: Graph-Regularized Sparse Autoencoders for Robust LLM Safety Steering
reasoning: The paper focuses on a technical method for steering LLM activations to improve safety by refusing harmful content and resisting jailbreak attacks. While safety is an ethical dimension, the research does not evaluate or benchmark religion, faith, or specific moral frameworks beyond general harmfulness refusal as defined by standard safety datasets like WildJailbreak.
